what: A rounded swatch row (pick color, mode, corner) with a single ring floating over it. Pressing another swatch sends the ring gliding to that spot on a spring (damping ratio .75 · about .65s, overshooting slightly at the end before settling). The ring wraps the swatch 2px outside with a 4px band, and hovering an unselected swatch swells it to 1.2x in .1s. Arrow keys move it too, and every pick fires fx:pick { value } Fires it off
ease: spring (stiffness 200 · damping 21.3 · mass 1) — original Framer Motion spring duration .65 · bounce .25 · hover transform .1s

options.--fx-ring · --fx-ring-size · --fx-ring-w: Ring color (default var(--kf-ink)) · diameter (default 43px) = Sample 39 + 4) · Band thickness (default 4px)
options.[role=radio] · [data-fx-part=option]: Sample (child) — aria-checked="true" The ring first settles on the item that is set. data-value is the value of fx:pick
options.fx:pick: Event fired from the row when an option is picked — detail.value · detail.option
